children.description: Acquire significant wealth through a business empire
Build a loyal inner circle of advisors and lieutenants
Secure a defensible territory as headquarters
Identify the three most credible threats
Form temporary alliances against the strongest of them
Strike decisively when an opening appears
Acquire major media outlets through shell companies
Develop covert surveillance and signals intelligence capability
Fund visible public-works projects in key regions
Suppress dissent through soft means before resorting to force
Cultivate a charismatic public persona — a cult of personality
Apply asymmetric economic pressure on holdouts
Project military force only when the time is right
Install loyal regional governors with limited autonomy
Standardize laws, currency, and language across the realm
Crush rebellions before they spread, but spare the contrite
